visual_review.text: Visually matches original Russian title and complete rules text, including original three-line rule layout.
visual_review.coins: Six gold coins in original left column.
visual_review.medallion: Purple/pink special-district medallion retained; small ornament details are regenerated.
visual_review.composition: Alchemist pose, rear-view figure, laboratory shelves, major tools, workbench, books, scale and skull remain closely aligned.
visual_review.limitations: More saturated amber light and more defined glassware, cloth, hair, tools and wood texture than original. The vague scan details are interpreted, so precise object-by-object and ornament fidelity cannot be guaranteed.
